_source: Order 66 Podcast — "Star Wars Vehicle Weapons for Genesys Rules" conversion table (Order_66_Conversion_Guide_Genesys_Vehicle_Rules_in_Star_Wars.pdf), cross-checked against Genesys Vehicle Combat Rules and Lessons.md
_notes: These are the Genesys-converted stats — do not use unconverted Star Wars FFG vehicle weapon stat blocks alongside this table.

General conversion rules for any vehicle weapon NOT in this table: reduce damage by 2; reduce Blast/Breach ratings by 2; increase Guided rating by 1; lasers trend Long range, ion cannons Long-to-Extreme, torpedoes/missiles Extreme, turbolasers/planetary-strike weapons Extreme-to-Strategic.
Range bands use the Genesys vehicle set: Engaged, Short, Medium, Long, Extreme, Strategic (Close is renamed Engaged).
